title: David Hochman on the State of Medtech Podcast
summary: Orchestra BioMed CEO David Hochman joins the State of Medtech podcast to discuss AVIM Therapy, MedTech innovation, partnerships, and bringing high-impact therapies to patients.
body_markdown:
Our CEO ***David Hochman*** , joined the[State of Medtech](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thestateofmedtech/) podcast to discuss all things Orchestra, from the partnership model behind our approach, to MedTech innovation, to what it really takes to bring high-impact therapies to patients.


Hear David break down how AVIM Therapy treats uncontrolled hypertension via a dual-chamber pacemaker, why partnerships are core to how Orchestra creates long-term value, and what separates the innovations strategics get excited about from the ones they pass on.
